newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary grants $25 mln to Holocaust victims.
newsitem.headline: Hungary grants $25 mln to Holocaust victims.

text.p: Hungary will grant four billion forints ($25 million) compensation to survivors of the Holocaust, a government official said on Thursday.

"The special compensation coupons will be handed over to the caretaker foundation which will distribute it in the form of annuity," government spokesman Elemer Kiss told a news conference following the weekly cabinet meeting.
Some 20,000 Hungarian Jewish survivors of the Holocaust would be entitled to the annuity.
Hungary, before World War Two, had an estimated 800,000 to one million Jews, one of the wealthiest Jewish communities in Europe.
